description.camera: Which camera to use. The choice is remembered.
description.camera-denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in the browser settings and reload the page.
description.camera-insecure: This page is not served over HTTPS. Browsers only hand out cameras in a secure context — open it over https:// or on localhost (in the dev server: "pnpm dev:mobile").
description.camera-missing: This device reports no camera at all.
description.camera-unavailable: The camera could not be opened. Usually another app or another tab is holding it.
description.card-language: Which language your cards are printed in. This picks the reading model and prefers matching printings.
description.index-not-loaded: The card index could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
description.live-scanner: Hold a card in front of the camera. Nothing is accepted until two frames agree.
description.load-card-data: The scanner recognises cards on your device, without sending them to a server. It downloads the card index once. After that it stays on the device and works without a connection.
description.metered-connection: You appear to be on a mobile connection. This download uses your data allowance.
description.new-scanner: Bench for the rebuilt recognition. Pick a photo, see the result and the timings.
description.no-session: What you scan lands in a staging area. The scanner opens the first one itself.
description.scan: Hold the cards up one after another. What is recognised lands in a list you review afterwards.
description.scope: Narrowing the scan down to the release you are currently sorting makes it faster and stops it confusing cards from other sets.
description.set-scope: Which sets the search is narrowed to. Cards from other sets are still recognised, just ranked behind.

label.camera-unknown: Available once the camera is allowed
label.data-missing: The scanner downloads {{size}} MB of card data once, on the first scan.
label.data-ready: The card data is on this device — the scanner works without a connection.
label.debug-not-confirmed: not verified yet, frames do not agree
label.hold-still: Looks like {{name}}, hold still for a moment
label.no-card: No card found in the image
label.point-at-card: Hold a card inside the guide
label.weak-match: Not confidently recognised, best match only {{count}} inliers
